rows.grounds: present participle of ava-īkṣ, describing īśvaram
agent of the fan-service expressed in kṛta+vyajanam
object of contemplation in the visualized form

items.question: In what attended form should the practitioner contemplate the lord?
premises: The lord is the object of contemplation.
Janaki performs fan-service for the lord.
The lord is beheld in that attended state.
items.inference: The practitioner should contemplate the lord as being fanned by Janaki and gazing upon her.
items.plain_english: One should contemplate the lord as he beholds Janaki, who is rendering him fan-service.
